relationshipDispositions.sourceTitle: Social anxiety disorder and the risk of depression: a prospective community study of adolescents and young adults
relationshipDispositions.evidenceFit: Prospective longitudinal community study. Among participants without depression at baseline, social anxiety disorder was associated with increased subsequent depressive-disorder onset. This supports the existing temporal association/risk proposition and not individual causation.
relationshipDispositions.guard: Keep the relationship as temporal association/risk only. Do not add direct-secondary, aggravation, causal pathway metadata, or pathwayIntelligence.

relationshipDispositions.sourceTitle: Incidence of social anxiety disorder and the consistent risk for secondary depression in the first three decades of life
relationshipDispositions.evidenceFit: Ten-year prospective longitudinal community/family study. Social anxiety disorder was consistently associated with subsequent depression after adjustment for age and sex. This supports the existing temporal association/risk proposition and not individual causation.
relationshipDispositions.guard: Keep the relationship as temporal association/risk only. Preserve age/population context and do not convert association into individual causation.

relationshipDispositions.sourceTitle: Management of aphonic patients following total laryngectomy and trachea esophageal puncture
relationshipDispositions.evidenceFit: Clinical series of patients after total laryngectomy plus tracheoesophageal puncture; six of 50 developed aphonia after surgery with persistent speech delay. This directly supports the already-bounded treatment-complication proposition.
relationshipDispositions.guard: Require documented total laryngectomy and separately documented aphonia/persistent failure to develop speech. Do not generalize aphonia to all laryngeal-cancer patients.

relationshipDispositions.sourceTitle: Effects of neck dissection and radiotherapy on short-term speech success in voice prosthesis restoration patients
relationshipDispositions.evidenceFit: Study of 32 men treated for laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma with total laryngectomy and primary tracheoesophageal voice-prosthesis restoration; five patients were aphonic. This supports the existing treatment-complication proposition.
relationshipDispositions.guard: Require documented total laryngectomy/voice-restoration context and separately documented aphonia or failure to develop speech. Do not attribute aphonia to radiotherapy or neck dissection from this source because those factors were not significant predictors.

relationshipDispositions.evidenceFit: The review addresses post-traumatic headache attributed to mild traumatic brain injury. It states that post-traumatic headache commonly resembles migraine or tension-type headache, but phenotype overlap does not make post-traumatic headache equivalent to the catalog diagnosis migraine-headaches.
relationshipDispositions.guard: Keep verified:false. Do not consume a citation-verification slot unless the taxonomy changes to a distinct post-traumatic-headache identity or a new source directly supports the existing migraine-headaches proposition.
relationshipDispositions.taxonomyPrerequisite: Add a distinct post-traumatic-headache catalog identity before publishing this pathway.
